title: 8 Doors a Godly Man Shuts Before Temptation Knocks
caption:
Most falls aren't decided in the moment. They're decided days before, when a man leaves the door open and tells himself he'll be strong later.

You won't be strong at 11 p.m. Nobody is. So shut the door on a good day. Close the tab. Delete the number. Charge the laptop somewhere else. Make a plan for Friday.

Killing sin isn't white-knuckling it in the moment. It's refusing to leave it a way in.

"Put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to gratify its desires." Romans 13:14

Save this. Pick one door and shut it tonight.
